_comment: Fake-API input config - the two inputs the brief asked for (area bbox, and crop/season-coded critical drought values) plus the sensor registry needed to place 7 synthetic sensors on it. Bbox matches clients/devinska.json's real alert_bbox, so the simulation sits over real, already-public plot geometry rather than an arbitrary rectangle. Edit freely - nothing here is read by the main pipeline (config.py/clients.py), this folder is self-contained.

moving_sensor.comment: Linear back-and-forth (triangle wave) between the two waypoints, one full A->B->A cycle every traverse_minutes - simulates a tractor/vehicle working the plot. Position is a pure function of elapsed time, not a random walk, so it's reproducible and always lands inside the bbox.

crop_seasonal_critical_soil_moisture._comment: Deterministic 'critically low' soil-moisture thresholds (raw sensor units, same unlabelled scale the real API reports - see data/verdantis-sensor-infra-reference.md). One row per crop, one column per season. Swap active_crop/active_season below, or add rows, to change what counts as drought-critical for the dashboard's status bar - no code change needed.
